auth.token_lifetime: STS AssumeRole session 1 hour default (standard; not re-fetched)
auth.refresh: We re-call sts:AssumeRole with the customer-specific ExternalId; no stored customer keys

access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Create an IAM role in their account with the trust policy and read-only policy in customer_grant_statements, then send us the role ARN. We generate the ExternalId, unique per customer: per AWS 'The ExternalId value must be unique among Example Corp's customers and controlled by Example Corp, not its customers.'
access_requirements.cost_to_us: S3 request and data-transfer fees borne by the customer account; we pay AWS STS nothing

customer_grant_statements: Trust policy on role LOVELEEDAYReadRole (per AWS confused-deputy doc, with ExternalId): {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"<LOVELEEDAY_AWS_ACCOUNT_ID>"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"sts:ExternalId":"<EXTERNAL_ID_WE_ISSUE>"}}}}

Permissions policy (list and read, adapted from AWS S3 example policies which use s3:ListBucket on the bucket ARN and s3:GetObject on bucket/*): {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:ListBucket","s3:GetBucketLocation"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::<BUCKET>"},{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:GetObjectVersion"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::<BUCKET>/<PREFIX>/*"}]}
Customer sends us: role ARN and bucket/prefix. KMS-encrypted buckets additionally need kms:Decrypt on the key (UNVERIFIED page not fetched).
rate_limits: S3 supports at least 5,500 GET/HEAD requests per second per prefix (UNVERIFIED, not fetched this run)
incremental_sync: S3 Event Notifications to SQS in the customer account (needs extra grant) or ListObjectsV2 with StartAfter / LastModified high-water mark; S3 Inventory for large buckets (UNVERIFIED, not fetched)

unified_api_coverage.airbyte_source: yes, S3 source exists (UNVERIFIED not fetched this run)

blockers: None: customer-grants-us-read cross-account role with ExternalId
sources: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-policies-s3.html — s3:ListBucket on bucket ARN, s3:GetObject on bucket/prefix/*
